scene_description: Scuffed, paint-stained wooden workbench. An empty filament spool lies flat with an orange scraper stuck blade-first in its center hole. Clear safety glasses stand on edge against the left side of the spool. Front is the bench edge nearest the viewer.

targets.name: filament spool
targets.description: Empty brown cardboard ELEGOO filament spool lying flat, with the scraper in its center hole and the glasses against its left side.
nearby_obstacles: Safety glasses against its left side
targets.clearance_notes: Right and front rims are open; the center hole is filled by the scraper.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the scraper out of the center hole and lay it flat on the bench.

targets.other_notes: Spool is empty and may need to be replaced.

targets.name: 3D print scraper
targets.description: Orange plastic 3D print scraper stuck blade-first in the spool's center hole, its handle angled up out of the hole.
targets.orientation: tilted, blade inserted in the spool hole
targets.clearance_notes: The handle sticks up and is exposed; the blade is held in the hole.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the scraper straight up out of the hole and lay it flat on the bench.

targets.name: safety glasses
targets.description: Clear plastic safety glasses standing on edge and leaning against the left side of the spool.
targets.orientation: leaning, standing on edge against the spool
targets.clearance_notes: Mostly exposed but propped on the spool and may fall; clear plastic is hard to see.

candidate_improvements.description: Lay the glasses down on the bench, clear of the spool.

source: Staged permutation of S0041 and S0045, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
